parameters.query:
SELECT u.id as user_id, u.telegram_bot_token, u.telegram_bot_username 
FROM users u 
WHERE u.telegram_chat_id = {{ $json.chat_id }}
   OR ('{{ $json.bot_token_from_webhook }}' != '' AND u.telegram_bot_token = '{{ $json.bot_token_from_webhook }}')
LIMIT 1
